title: Observability: metrics + alerts for Optimize config apply/rollback (correlation ids, stuck rollouts, failure rate)
creator: Allison Grant
content:
Context
We’re adding safe-apply + rollback for Optimize config changes. SRE requirement: operators must be able to (a) see apply/rollback health in near real-time, (b) correlate config change operations to downstream latency/error spikes, and (c) page on elevated failure rate / stuck propagation.

This ticket adds first-class metrics (control plane + runtime) and alerting semantics for config change operations, plus correlation id propagation into traces/logs.

Goals / Outcomes
- Make every apply/rollback attempt observable with consistent identifiers:
  - operation_id (server-generated) and idempotency_key (client-supplied) surfaced in metrics/logs.
  - config_version_id + target scope (customer/region/cluster/route/model) in metric labels with strict cardinality limits.
- Standard metrics for dashboards + alerting:
  - Apply/rollback success rate and failure reasons
  - Apply/rollback end-to-end latency (including propagation)
  - “Stuck rollout” detection (in-progress operations not completing within SLO)
- Alerts that page on-call for:
  - Elevated failure rate
  - Stuck rollouts
  - Control plane ↔ runtime status reporting issues

Non-goals
- Building new dashboards from scratch for unrelated services.
- Automated rollback (human confirmation remains in scope per PRD).

Metric Spec (proposed)

Naming
- Prefix: optimize_config_* (preferred) OR config_change_* (fallback). Align with existing conventions from serving control-plane.
- Use Prometheus-style metrics for internal; also emit to our metrics pipeline with consistent dimensions.

Identifiers and dimensions (label policy)
- Required labels (low cardinality):
  - env (prod|staging|dev)
  - deployment_mode (hosted|dedicated|private)
  - operation (apply|rollback)
  - outcome (success|failure|canceled|timeout)
- Optional labels (guarded by cardinality controls / sampling):
  - failure_reason (enum, see below)
  - scope_type (route|customer|cluster|region|model)
  - tenant_tier (free|pro|enterprise)
- DO NOT label by: raw customer_id, raw route_id, request_id. Those must live in logs/traces only.
- Correlation fields for logs/traces:
  - operation_id (UUID)
  - idempotency_key (string)
  - config_version_id (e.g., v17)
  - applied_from_version_id (for rollbacks)

Metrics
1) Counters
- optimize_config_operations_total{operation, outcome, failure_reason?, env, deployment_mode}
  - Increment once per completed operation (apply/rollback).
- optimize_config_operation_attempts_total{operation, env, deployment_mode}
  - Increment at operation start.
- optimize_config_propagation_events_total{event}
  - event enum: started|progressed|completed|runtime_ack|runtime_nack

2) Histograms
- optimize_config_operation_latency_seconds{operation, env, deployment_mode}
  - Wall-clock latency from operation accepted → completed (includes propagation).
  - Buckets: 0.5s, 1s, 2s, 5s, 10s, 20s, 40s, 60s, 120s, 300s
- optimize_config_preflight_latency_seconds{env, deployment_mode}
  - Validator runtime.
- optimize_config_propagation_latency_seconds{env, deployment_mode}
  - Time from “config committed” to “runtime ack complete.”

3) Gauges
- optimize_config_operations_in_flight{env, deployment_mode}
  - Increment on start, decrement on completion.
- optimize_config_oldest_in_flight_age_seconds{env, deployment_mode}
  - Helps detect stuck rollouts without high-cardinality per-operation metrics.

Failure reason enum
- authz_denied
- preflight_failed
- conflict_concurrent_operation
- propagation_timeout
- runtime_apply_failed
- storage_error
- unknown

Correlation IDs propagation
- Control plane API should accept X-Redwood-Idempotency-Key (already in rollback/apply APIs) and attach:
  - operation_id returned in response body + response header X-Redwood-Operation-Id
  - operation_id and config_version_id added to structured logs for all steps
- Runtime apply/rollback hooks must emit runtime logs with operation_id and status.
- Console should surface operation_id as a copyable field in UI (handled in ENG-4826 / Console work), but this ticket ensures the backend emits it.

Dashboards (owned by Observability pack)
- “Optimize Config Change Health” dashboard panels:
  - Operations rate + success/failure (stacked)
  - p50/p95/p99 operation latency
  - In-flight operations + oldest age
  - Failure reasons breakdown
  - Propagation latency and runtime nack rate
  - Links: last 50 operation_ids (from logs search) - implemented as dashboard text + log query template

Alerting
SLO targets (per SRE thread)
- Apply/rollback should complete within 2 minutes for hosted (p95), 5 minutes for dedicated/private (p95) under normal conditions.

Alert rules (initial defaults; tune post-beta)
1) Elevated failure rate
- Condition: optimize_config_operations_total{outcome="failure"} / optimize_config_operations_total{outcome!="canceled"} > 5% over 10m AND attempts_total > 20
- Page: #oncall-platform (prod only)
- Ticket: auto-create if persists > 30m

2) Stuck rollout
- Condition: optimize_config_oldest_in_flight_age_seconds > 600 (prod hosted) OR > 1200 (dedicated/private) for 10m
- Page: #oncall-platform
- Include runbook link + log query template with operation_id hints.

3) Runtime ACK gap
- Condition: propagation_events_total{event="runtime_ack"} / propagation_events_total{event="started"} < 0.95 over 15m (if started > 20)
- Severity: page in prod; warn in staging

Implementation Plan
- Control plane service:
  - Add metrics instrumentation around apply + rollback endpoints (attempt/start, preflight, commit, propagation complete).
  - Ensure operation_id is consistently attached to context/logger.
- Runtime:
  - Emit runtime_apply_failed/runtime_nack and ack events with operation_id.
- Observability pack:
  - Add dashboards + alert rules (PR in observability-pack).
- Validate cardinality:
  - Verify that no label includes high-cardinality identifiers. Add tests/linters if needed.

Acceptance Criteria
- Metrics visible in prod sandbox within 24h of deploy.
- Dashboard exists with the panels listed above.
- Alerts fire correctly in staging with synthetic failures:
  - forced runtime nack
  - forced propagation timeout
- operation_id present in:
  - API response
  - control plane logs
  - runtime logs

Testing
- Unit tests for metrics emission on success + failure paths.
- Integration test in staging: apply + rollback flow generates attempt/completed counters and latency histograms.
- Synthetic canary job (manual for beta): run 10 apply operations with induced timeout to ensure stuck rollout alert triggers.

References / Links
- Confluence PRD: safe apply + rollback mechanism (Marissa Cole)
- Related issues: ENG-4823 (rollback endpoint), ENG-4827 (runtime apply atomicity/locking), ENG-4824 (preflight validator)
- GitHub:
  - redwood/pr-10479-runtime-apply-locking-and-propagation-status (adds status reporting + some metrics hooks)
  - observability-pack/pr-733-dashboards-config-change-health-and-rollback (dashboards + alert rules)
  - incident-bot/pr-219-post-config-change-alerts-and-rollback-links (optional: uses operation_id for incident context)

Open Questions
- Do we need a separate metric for “operation created vs applied” to account for async workflows? Current plan uses attempts_total (start) and operations_total (completion) + in_flight/oldest_age.
- Should the stuck-rollout threshold vary by cluster size? For now: environment + deployment_mode only.

Rollout
- Stage 1: staging + internal hosted sandbox
- Stage 2: hosted prod (alerts in warn-only for 48h)
- Stage 3: dedicated + private (alerts enabled; thresholds adjusted)

---
Updates / Comments

2025-02-10 (Aisha Bello)
- Drafted metric names + buckets; synced with Allison on label cardinality. Biggest risk is scope explosion if we include customer_id/route_id; keeping those in logs only.
- Waiting on ENG-4827 runtime ack/nack events shape to finalize propagation metrics.

2025-02-18 (Caleb Johnson)
- Confirmed we can attach operation_id to trace spans in control plane with existing context propagation. Please don’t add idempotency_key as a metric label.

2025-02-21 (Sean Gallagher)
- SRE asks for “oldest in-flight age” gauge specifically; we’ve had too many stuck deploys where in-flight count was non-zero but hard to reason about. Also want alert to include runbook link.

2025-02-26 (Allison Grant)
- Reviewed observability-pack/pr-733: dashboard panels look good. Requested adding failure_reason breakdown and a text panel with log query template.

2025-03-03 (Aisha Bello)
- Implemented metrics in control plane; added runtime ack gap alert in staging only pending more data. Moved status to In Review; requesting review from Sean + Allison.
